notes.title: Update 1.0.07 – Mouse Invert Feature Added
notes.notes: You can now invert the X and Y mouse axes in the settings menu. This new option lets you customize mouse controls to match your preferred playstyle.

notes.title: 🎉 Release Date Announcement – April 16, 2025 (Pending Approval)
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

I'm excited to finally announce a release date for the game: April 16, 2025!
(As long as everything goes smoothly with Steam’s final approval.)

As a solo developer, this has been a long journey — full of challenges, learning, and a lot of love poured into every detail. I'm incredibly proud of how far it's come, and I'm even more excited to finally share it with you.

Thank you so much for your support
Joaquin.

notes.title: The Empty Desk - Demo Release Date Revealed!
notes.notes:
It’s ready! I’m beyond excited to finally share the demo of The Empty Desk with all of you.

On January 22, 2025, you’ll step into the shoes of Detective Bennett and join him on his latest investigation—one that will take you deeper into the shadows than ever before.

A quiet office.
An unsolved disappearance.
A building hiding more secrets than it lets on...

Are you prepared to uncover the truth lurking beneath the surface? The demo will give you a first glimpse into the eerie twists and chilling discoveries that lie ahead.

Mark the date, detective—January 22, 2025. Blackthorn’s secrets await.

The game needs you, and only you can crack this case. Share the news, spread the word, and I can't wait to hear your thoughts!

Will you dare to take on the challenge?
